summary.headline: Anubion, Valens, and Saturn
summary.text: Editorial discussion attributes epic-style astrological paraphrases to Anubion or Dorotheus, compares their order of aspects with Firmicus, and identifies chapters on the seven stars as drawn from Valens and Ptolemy. A new section begins on the mixture and nature of stars, opening with Saturn’s effects, including malice, arrogance, anxiety, solitude, hypocrisy, stinginess, and austerity.
